c74object.name: evi_utilities
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_utilities.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_utilities.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_utilities.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
About this File:
These utilities get used all over evieve. They are a hodge podge of converters, sample accurate processors, mappers and mixing functions. Requiring this .genexpr file also inherits 'evi_approx.genexpr'.

entry.name: logicalClicks ( )
entry.description:
Similar to [click~] in MSP, outputs sample accurate clicks for all directions
In 1: type=input: x, Trigger
Return 1: Updown, Output trigger for either direction
Return 2: Up, Output trigger if up direction
Return 3: Down, Output trigger if down direction

entry.name: triggerHoldGate ( )
entry.description:
In 1: type=input: X, Trigger (anything > 0)
In 2: type=param (optional): hold, default: 10, Hold time in ms (0-ms = 1-sample click)
In 3: type=param (optional): trigger, default: 1, Trigger response, 0 = up/down, 1 = up only, 2 = down only
Return 1: Gate, Sample accurate gate with hold duration

entry.name: varDcblock ( )
entry.description:
Variable dcblock() so that effect can be bypassed (a0 = 1) or active (a0 = 0.9997) or heavy (a0 = ...)
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a0, Dc coefficient, typically 0.9997 for basic dcblock()
Return 1: Audio output, Dc blocked audio output

entry.name: preWarpG ( )
entry.description:
Warp Hz..g for trapezoidal linear rc filters
In 1: type=input: cutoff, in Hz
Return 1: G, g coefficient for trapezoidal linear rc filters

entry.name: getMax ( )
entry.description:
Return absolute maximum of left and right audio inputs
In 1: type=input: xL, Left audio input
In 2: type=input: xR, Right audio input
Return 1: Absolute max, Per sample maximum of left and right inputs

entry.name: xSgn ( )
entry.description:
Return sign of input but only reports -1 or 1 (no zero)
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Sign, -1 or 1

entry.name: xRange ( )
entry.description:
Clip the abs(x) to maximum 1
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Clip, 0..1 (abs(x) to maximum 1)

entry.name: bandwidth2Q ( )
entry.description:
Convert octaves to Q
In 1: type=input: bandwidth, in Octaves
Return 1: Q, Approximate Q of bandwidth

entry.name: Q2bandwidth ( )
entry.description:
Convert Q to bandwidth
In 1: type=input: Q, in Q
Return 1: Octaves, Approximate octaves of Q

entry.name: pitch2timeSamps ( )
entry.description:
Convert pitch to time in samples
In 1: type=input: size, Pitch
Return 1: Samples, Size in samples

entry.name: pitch2timeSecs ( )
entry.description:
Convert pitch to time in seconds
In 1: type=input: size, Pitch
Return 1: Seconds, Size in seconds

entry.name: decorelate ( )
entry.description:
Post-filter to decolorate (oscillator) waveshapers when antialiasing is used, e.g. polyBlep or Adaa, Stefano D'Angelo, GPL v3
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
Return 1: Audio output, Decorrelated audio output

entry.name: eviScurve ( )
entry.description:
S-curve segment maker for linear 0..1 input, e.g. for 'eviSline()'
In 1: type=input: segment, Input 0..1
Return 1: S-curve, S-curve for 0..1 input

entry.name: eviMap ( )
entry.description:
Basic linear scaling like linear part of [scale], for when only linear is needed, only about 1.15 x faster than using library scale() but still worth it
In 1: type=input: valueIn, Input
In 2: type=input: inLow, Low in value
In 3: type=input: inHigh, High in value
In 4: type=input: outLow, Low out value
In 5: type=input: outHigh, High out value
Return 1: Scaled, Scaled value output

entry.name: eviZmap ( )
entry.description:
Basic linear scaling, sort of like [zmap], a clamped version of 'eviMap()'
In 1: type=input: valueIn, Input
In 2: type=input: inLow, Low in value
In 3: type=input: inHigh, High in value
In 4: type=input: outLow, Low out value
In 5: type=input: outHigh, High out value
Return 1: Mapped, Mapped value output

entry.name: kinky ( )
entry.description:
Like MSP [kink~]
In 1: type=input: p, Phase (0..1)
In 2: type=input: k, Kink 0..1
Return 1: Shape, Phase shaped kinky output

entry.name: sin7 ( )
entry.description:
Sine approx, 5 muls 3 plus, terrible accuracy but cheap, for lfos etc only
In 1: type=input: x1, -1..1 input, this is not sin(), it is between sin and cos
Return 1: Sine, Approximate sin() of input in range -1..1

entry.name: parabolWrap ( )
entry.description:
Very cheap parabolic approximation for LFOs etc, -1..1
In 1: type=input: phase, Sin phase 0..1
Return 1: Sine, Approximate sin() of input in range -1..1

entry.name: windowCoeffs ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients for Data() calculation and storage of 5 different window types, @see: 'winMan()'
In 1: type=input: choice, 1=Blackman, 2=Exact Blackman, 3=Blackman-Harris, 4=Hann, 5=Hamming
Return 1: a0, a0 coefficient
Return 2: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 3: a2, a2 coefficient

entry.name: winMan ( )
entry.description:
For use with 'windowCoeffs()' in a for loop to fill a Data()
In 1: type=input: w, loop iterator
In 2: type=input: a0, a0 coefficient
In 3: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 5: type=param (optional): windowsize, default: 4096,
Return 1: Size, Window size in samples
